skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the principles and theories of comparative economics, including the classification of economic systems and their characteristics.
Develop the ability to critically evaluate economic systems and their performance, including growth, efficiency, and stability.
Learn to gather, analyze, and interpret data from reliable sources to support economic analyses.
Analyze global issues such as climate change, globalization, and economic crises, and propose solutions for future economic development.
Understand and apply professional ethics and social responsibility in economic research and practice.
Improve communication skills through class participation, discussions, and presentations.
Work effectively in groups to analyze and present economic data and theories.
Develop the ability to independently study and research economic topics.
